claim_scope: Consumed-development mechanism study only. This run cannot support an effectiveness, generalization, held-out, or leaderboard claim.
research_question: Does V2.1 preserve a real Observation-to-Constraint-to-Operation transition by separating the read-only initial observation from candidate admissibility, while retaining exact source-provenance repair feedback for model-submitted programs?

case.selection_reason: V1 exposed a false-success mechanism on this case, and the first V2 attempt exposed an observation-role boundary error before any valid model round. The case is reused only to validate that correction.

prior_failure.required_correction: The read-only initial observation executes the public goal without candidate provenance attribution. Every model-submitted program remains subject to V2 source-provenance audit.

mechanism_checks.pass_condition: Candidate stateful-initial-observation executes the public goal before agent round 1 without candidate source-provenance attribution, while model-submitted programs retain the V2 provenance audit.
mechanism_checks.failure_condition: The probe is blocked by base-image provenance, or a model candidate bypasses candidate provenance.

mechanism_checks.pass_condition: The round-1 state projection contains the initial probe's complete public goal report and the probe is not counted as a model round.
mechanism_checks.failure_condition: The first model prompt has no executable-goal report, or the probe consumes a model candidate.

mechanism_checks.pass_condition: The structured round-1 projection contains a non-empty active goal-obligation frontier derived from the shared probe.
mechanism_checks.failure_condition: The projection contains only repository metadata or an empty frontier despite a failing probe.

mechanism_checks.pass_condition: Any model candidate that adds divergent Python source beneath a project-provided namespace is rejected with project-namespace-provenance feedback.
mechanism_checks.failure_condition: Such a model candidate is certified or reaches official evaluation as an eligible reproduction.

mechanism_checks.pass_condition: If a model candidate is rejected for divergent source, the next independent model session receives the exact rejected program, violation, and verification summary.
mechanism_checks.not_exercised_condition: No model candidate triggers the provenance boundary; report this separately and do not infer repair behavior.

mechanism_checks.pass_condition: Any claimed generation success passes the public goal, repository effect audit, and V2 source-provenance audit in a fresh environment.
mechanism_checks.failure_condition: Official Pass or clean replay alone is treated as sufficient.

round-1 raw-evidence parity and structured frontier
